adjacency.source: global canonical Natural Earth application-country topology

boundaryPolicy.canadaUnitedStates: canonical whole-country CAN/USA; USA remote multipart components are excluded from viewport fit/focus only, never from scored geometry or Outlines
boundaryPolicy.southAmericaContext: COL and VEN are keyed non-scoring context; PAN-COL adjacency remains global
boundaryPolicy.franceNetherlandsContext: FRA and NLD are keyed non-scoring context clipped to Caribbean overseas geometry; metropolitan Europe is not loaded into this viewport
boundaryPolicy.greenland: non-scoring Danish context; rendered when visible but excluded from projection fit
boundaryPolicy.bermuda: non-scoring British dependency context; rendered when visible but excluded from projection fit
boundaryPolicy.saintPierreAndMiquelon: non-scoring French dependency context near Canada
boundaryPolicy.puertoRico: non-scoring United States dependency context in the Caribbean
boundaryPolicy.britishCaribbean: Anguilla, British Virgin Islands, Cayman Islands, Montserrat and Turks and Caicos Islands are non-scoring context
boundaryPolicy.frenchCaribbean: Saint Barthelemy and Saint Martin are non-scoring source context; FRA Caribbean geometry is keyed non-scoring context
boundaryPolicy.dutchCaribbean: Aruba, Curacao and Sint Maarten are non-scoring source context; NLD Caribbean geometry is keyed non-scoring context
boundaryPolicy.disputedBanks: Bajo Nuevo Bank and Serranilla Bank remain non-scoring Natural Earth indeterminate context
boundaryPolicy.guantanamo: Natural Earth Guantanamo Bay lease remains non-scoring context and is not promoted to an Atlas country
boundaryPolicy.usMinorOutlyingIslands: explicitly excluded from North America runtime context because remote Pacific dependencies are irrelevant to this learner viewport
boundaryPolicy.maritimeAdjacency: none; topology-derived land adjacency only, including explicit empty sets
boundaryPolicy.assistance: real polygons first; invisible hit assistance for BHS/BLZ/DOM/HTI/JAM/SLV/TTO; true-scale insets for KNA+ATG, DMA+LCA and VCT+GRD+BRB; no leader-line callouts or schematic relocation

runtimeOptimization.method: projection-space path quantization plus Ramer-Douglas-Peucker for non-interactive physical context
